assertionMovements.rationale: Defaults, normalization, accepted values, production warnings, and expected configuration errors are deterministic createConfig behavior and do not need one fresh Node process per case.

The discovered source regression remains active and owns child-process environment materialization, startup/import failure propagation, the disposable database and module registry, version/runtime documentation contracts, and runtime/app-info consumer integration.

assertionMovements.rationale: Package, lock-root, and lock-package current-version equality was repeated across legacy regressions even though the direct version guard already owns the canonical runtime and metadata relationship.
assertionMovements.assertionDisposition: scripts/version-literal-guardrail-regression.mjs owns package.json, both package-lock version fields, the runtime helper, app-info, changelog heading, and roadmap advancement; release.closeout-conductor runs that direct gate once.

assertionMovements.rationale: Legacy regressions repeatedly asserted their own or a consolidated owner's snapshot membership even though discovery and the generated manifest already reconcile every active and credited-retired path.
assertionMovements.assertionDisposition: release.regression-manifest-generation owns exact discovered membership, legacy snapshot reconciliation, required release gates, credited retirements, and stale-manifest failure proof.

assertionMovements.rationale: Feature regressions repeated a dynamic current-version CHANGELOG heading check unrelated to their behavior contract.
assertionMovements.assertionDisposition: The direct version guard owns the one current CHANGELOG heading check while historical feature-specific changelog assertions remain with their feature regressions.

assertionMovements.rationale: Exact root package-script strings were distributed across feature and release regressions, making command wiring a many-owner contract.
assertionMovements.assertionDisposition: scripts/package-script-contracts.json is the reviewed exact command inventory and release.validation-single-ownership is its single execution owner; feature regressions keep behavior and independent-runnability assertions.

assertionMovements.rationale: The fast-check regression repeated TypeScript compiler scope facts already enforced by the framework typecheck-seams release gate.
assertionMovements.assertionDisposition: framework.typecheck-seams remains the single regression owner for noEmit, allowJs, selective checkJs, strict compiler settings, and included type contracts; fast-check still owns command ordering and dependency boundaries.

assertionMovements.rationale: Pure assetVersion and withAssetVersion return-value examples were duplicated between Vitest and the framework integration regression.

assertionMovements.rationale: Producer allowlist and recursive metadata scrubbing are deterministic payload transformations and do not need database initialization.
